q: Use Morbent's Bane on Morbent Fel, kill Morbent Fel, then return Morbent's Bane to Sven at his camp.
Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.
Scout Riell at the Sentinel Hill Tower wants you to bring her 10 Red Silk Bandanas.
Bring 6 samples of Lake Creeper Moss, 6 samples of Lake Skulker Moss and a Hardened Tumor to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
Bring the Rendered Spores to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff, before the time limit is up.
Help Deathstalker Faerleia kill the Pyrewood Council.
Locate Captain Sanders' chest and open it for your reward.
Bring Magmar Fellhew 8 Carved Stone Idols.
Kill 12 Rattlecage Skeletons, and then return to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell when you are done.
Apothecary Johaan in the town of Brill wants you to bring him 4 samples of venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider.
Motley Garmason wants Kam Deepfury's head brought to him at Dun Modr.
Bring 6 Pyrewood Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
Ormer Ironbraid at the Whelgar Excavation Site wants you to kill Sarltooth and return to him with one of his talons once the task is fulfilled.
Darren Malvew of Southshore wants you to kill 8 Mountain Lions and 10 Hulking Mountain Lions.
Dizzy One-Eye in Booty Bay wants you to retrieve his eye from the Bloodsail Buccaneers.
Fleet-Master Seahorn in Booty Bay wants you to kill Captain Stillwater, Captain Keelhaul and Fleet Master Firallon.
Consume the Water of the Seers in front of the tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village and follow the vision once it appears.
Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 7 Plainstrider Feathers and 7 pieces of Plainstrider Meat.
Find Ryedol's Lucky Pick and return it to Prospector Ryedol south of Hammertoe's Dig Site.
Plant the Tainted Heart in Denalan's Planter.
Bring 6 Pyrewood Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
Bring 60 Bristleback Quilboar Tusks to Mankrik at the Crossroads.
Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth wants you to collect the Gargantuan Tumor from Oakenscowl.
Collect 7 Small Spider Legs for Zarrin in Dolanaar.
Archaeologist Flagongut in Menethil Harbor wants you to bring him the Stone of Relu and Flagongut's Fossil.
Return to Thyn'tel Bladeweaver in Darnassus.
Conservator Ilthalaine needs you to kill 7 Mangy Nightsabers and 7 Thistle Boars.
Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Varimathras in the Undercity.
Find 3 Soran'ruk Fragments and 1 Large Soran'ruk Fragment and return them to Doan Karhan in the Barrens.
Bring the Cask of Scalder to Furen Longbeard.
Find and kill the Den Mother.
Bring four Bronze Battleaxes and four Bronze Warhammers to Orokk Omosh in Orgrimmar.
Bring three Snickerfang Jowls, two Blasted Boar Lungs, and one Scorpok Pincer to Bloodmage Drazial.
Bring three Snickerfang Jowls, two Blasted Boar Lungs, and one Scorpok Pincer to Bloodmage Drazial.
Bring Balnir Snapdragons to Anastasia Hartwell in the Mage Quarter of the Undercity.
Bring the Brilliant Gold Ring, a Silver Bar, a Moss Agate, and 30 silver coins to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.
Bring the Sealed Field Testing Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
Orwin Gizzmick in Camp Mojache wants 12 samples of Gordunni Cobalt.
Bring 10 Monstrous Crawler Legs to Dar in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Tharg in Brackenwall Village wants you to kill 10 Firemane Scouts, 10 Firemane Ash Tails, and 5 Firemane Scalebanes.
Bring Gahz'rilla's Electrified Scale to Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
Use the Sign of the Earth to activate the Pillars of Amethyst, Opal, and Diamond and obtain the Runestones.
Use the Sign of the Earth to activate the Pillars of Diamond, Opal, and Amethyst and obtain the Runestones.
Speak with J.D. Collie in a moment.
Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.
Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.
Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar.

Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrat
Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.
Fill the Empty Cleansing Bowl at the Auberdine Moonwell.
Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.
Slay Arikara. Bring her remains and the Incendia powder to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post as proof of your deed.
Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.
Take Umi's Mechanical Yeti and scare her friends with it:
Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.
Collect the Warsong Supplies: Warsong Saw Blades, Logging Rope, Warsong Oil, and the Warsong Axe Shipment for Locke Okarr in Splintertree Post.
Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete.
Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.
Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.
Return the book to its rightful owners.

If you bring me your white stallion, I'll trade you for one from the new herd. The new horse will be just as fast as your old one, but have a different look to it. You can look at the swift steeds here to see what it will look like.
Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.
Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village with news of his rescue.
Bring me thise things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
Paragons of Power: The Madcap's Tunic
Bring Falthir the Sightless a Primal Hakkari Aegis. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
Destroy any one of the Hakkari Bijous found in Zul'Gurub at the Altar of Zanza on Yojamba Isle. When done, speak with Vinchaxa nearby.
Could I get a Fishing Flier?
Could I get a Fishing Flier?
Bring a total of 6 Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in sunken temple.
Bring an Abyssal Scepter to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
Bring Vyral's Signet Ring to Huum Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

Bring 5 Cenarion Combat Badges, 3 Cenarion Logistics Badges and 7 Cenarion Tactical Badges to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Friendly reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.
Salfa wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Shaman, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Ursa. Salfa is located just outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold in Winterspring.

Bring Ouro's Intact Hide, 2 Idols of the Sage, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Bring the the Carapace of the Old God, 2 Idols of Life, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
Bring 1 Qiraji Martial Drape, 2 Onyx Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
Bring 1 Qiraji Regal Drape, 2 Amber Idols, 5 Ivory Scarabs and 5 Bronze Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
Bring a Belt of Valor and a set of Gauntlets of Valor to Deliana in Ironforge.
Bring a Belt of Valor and a set of Gauntlets of Valor to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Bring a Magister's Belt and a set of Magister's Gloves to Deliana in Ironforge.
Bring a Magister's Belt and a set of Magister's Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Bring a Lightforge Belt and a set of Lightforge Gauntlets to Deliana in Ironforge.
Dirk Thunderwood at Cenarion Hold wants you to bring him Venoxis's Venom Sac and Kurinnaxx's Venom Sac.

Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Redemption Handguards if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Handguards, 8 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 5 Cured Rugged Hides.

Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Frostfire Circlet if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Circlet, 15 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 3 Mooncloth and 3 Nexus Crystals.
Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Frozen Runes, 16 Heavy Scorpid Scale, 5 Essence of Water, 3 Cured Rugged Hides and 200 gold.
Superior Armaments of Battle - Friend of the Dawn
For 30 Insignias of the Dawn and 30 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
Superior Armaments of Battle - Honored Amongst the Dawn
For 20 Insignias of the Dawn and 20 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
Superior Armaments of Battle - Revered Amongst the Dawn
For 7 Insignias of the Dawn and 7 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
Superior Armaments of Battle - Exalted Amongst the Dawn
For 6 Insignias of the Dawn and 6 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
Return your ward to the Stormwind orphanage by handing in the Human Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Nightingale in the Cathedral District.
Return your ward to the Orgrimmar orphanage by handing in the Orcish Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Battlewail in the Valley of Honor.
Go to a summoning circle and kill a Shadow of Doom, then return to Commander Thomas Helleran at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

Check your map to find an area under Scourge attack. Go there and damage a necropolis by defeating the Scourge around them. Return 10 of their Necrotic Runes to Commander Thomas Helleran at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Take the Letter from the Keeper of the Rolls to him at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Bring the Cracked Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Orrin outside the gates of Stormwind.
Bring the Faint Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Rukag in the courtyard of the Undercity.
